description: Canonical evidence inventory for the AgentDojo live evaluation. Lists every artifact a paper or spec claim rests on, so the claim stays auditable from version control alone. This file records an index, not a measurement: it must never be read as evidence in place of the artifact it points at.
hash_encoding: sha256 and size are over LF-normalised content (what Git stores), so a core.autocrlf=true checkout does not invalidate them
indexed_granularity: One entry per top-level run artifact (manifest.json, index.jsonl, report.json, sidecar.jsonl, derived attribution files). Per-cell substance -- the agentshield-*/ trajectory logs and the new sidecar/ per-cell gate artifacts -- is committed next to those files but not hashed individually here, so the index stays small enough to review; a cell's outcome is also on its index.jsonl row. Frozen directories from the 120B pair are indexed under this same rule.

canonical_artifacts.purpose: The single validity measurement the confirmatory replication consumes: 120B, 14 injection tasks run as user tasks under no_governance with no attack, 9 solvable
canonical_artifacts.claim_supported: spec 7 shared validity freeze: the denominator of every replication arm is a measurement made once, whose identity is this run's manifest_hash (recorded as the freeze's source_run_id)

canonical_artifacts.purpose: Per-cell outcomes of the validity measurement, 14 cells, cell_kind=validity
canonical_artifacts.claim_supported: spec 7 shared validity freeze: which 9 of the 14 injection tasks passed the suite's official utility check, and therefore which tasks are in every arm's denominator

canonical_artifacts.purpose: The frozen denominator itself, carrying validity_freeze_sha256 over a canonical serialisation of its substantive fields
canonical_artifacts.claim_supported: spec 7: every replication arm must cite validity_freeze_sha256 c6ebde9c637b26a5caac866a3edea391edc6a5a443745e096db3c94c563d3886 in its manifest, and a run whose freeze is missing, edited, or measured on another suite/model/version stops before credentials are read (exit 6). The sha256 above is over this file's bytes as Git stores them; the c6eb... value is the semantic hash over the freeze's fields, which is what arms cite.

known_gaps.what_it_means: The 120B governed report's gate statistics describe only the 3 cells of the run's final invocation, because the pre-per-cell sidecar was truncated at the top of every invocation and cached cells wrote no rows. The field is not wrong about what it counted; it is easy to misread as covering the arm. Per-cell coverage for the paired 80-cell comparison is in attribution.json next to it (57 of 80 mapped).
known_gaps.remedy_applied_for_future_runs: one sidecar artifact per cell, keyed by cell identity, written atomically (harness change; gate_source_sha256 moved, so these directories are no longer resumable under their run-tags)

known_gaps.observed: 9 solvable in the 2026-09-27 arm, 8 in the 2026-09-29 arm; difference is injection_task_10 alone
known_gaps.what_it_means: The two arms measured their own validity legs two days apart at temperature 0 and disagreed on one task, so every Step 9 number is computed on the 80-cell intersection of the two frozen sets rather than on either directory's own denominator.
known_gaps.remedy_applied_for_future_runs: --validity-only writes one shared validity_freeze.json whose sha256 every arm must cite; the freeze is in CACHE_COMPARED_KEYS and a mismatch fails closed (exit 6)

known_gaps.what_it_means: 6 of the 15 security flips occurred in cells where the gate actually intervened, 3 have blocked_calls=0 and 6 (all user_task_28) are unmapped. Occurrence is not proof of cause, which is the wording the spec already uses.
known_gaps.remedy_applied_for_future_runs: per-cell sidecar artifacts remove the truncation, so the confirmatory replication reports attribution at full coverage
